messages:
alex: Heads-up — propose we introduce a lightweight compatibility adapter layer in partner SDKs to handle the upcoming request schema/semantics change (this is a breaking change for naive SDKs). Need a short plan covering marketplace bundles, hardware vendor SDKs, and SI integrations. Thoughts? :thinking:

marina: What exactly is changing? header vs payload shape? We need a compatibility matrix per partner (pinning, signed firmware, hosted vs self-hosted). Also recommend a version-gating policy (minor vs major).

devon: +1 for adapter. Implementation idea: runtime detection + env opt-in flag. Example shim snippet for Node SDK:
```
function send(req) {
  if (req.headers['x-rd-new'] || process.env.RI_FORCE_NEW === '1') return newSend(req)
  return legacySend(req)
}
module.exports = { send }
```
Publish as small adapter packages (npm/pypi) so partners can drop-in.

sara-partners: For marketplace listings we should expose a 'compatibility toggle' in the vendor console so SIs and partners can opt into the new behavior on a schedule. Recommend 6-month deprecation window with an opt-in default for the first 3 months. We should also prepare joint comms templates for partners and SIs.

alex: Good call. We also need telemetry tags (compat_adapter_v1 + partner_id) and metrics to track opt-ins and errors. Rollout plan: canary -> partner-bucket (selected partners) -> global. Can workspace apps and SI-managed installs opt-in separately? @sara-partners

sara-partners: Yes — marketplace/partner listing flows can have per-install toggles and a vendor-level opt-in. We'll prepare the UI mock and comms. Proposed timeline: partner comms week 1, public deprecation notice week 3, SDK adapters + migration guides week 4.

partners-bot: Compatibility scan complete: 12 partners flagged for manual review (mix of hardware SDK pinning and legacy webhook shapes). See issue: <https://issues.redwood/COMPAT-2141>

devon: I can run partner smoke tests and publish initial adapters. Need partner contact list, test endpoints, and signatures for hardware vendors. Also propose a 'no-break' release channel for hardware partners where we ship adapter + pinned runtime.

marina: I'll generate a compatibility CSV with columns: partner, sdk_language, sdk_pinned_versions, firmware_dependency, marketplace_listing, SI_contact, test_endpoint, test_coverage. Will share by Friday EOD.

alex: Action items and tentative deadlines: devon publish initial adapters (target: 2141660000), marina share CSV (target: 2141640000), sara prepare partner comms + marketplace opt-in flows and UI mock (target: 2141700000). We'll sync Thu 10am to finalize partner list and canary partners. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sara-partners: I'll also draft a partner-facing migration checklist (breaking change summary, rollback steps, test commands, expected timeline). Posting draft to the partners folder by tomorrow.

devon: One more technical note — for hardware partners we should support an 'adapter build' that can be bundled into their firmware signing pipeline to avoid runtime network differences.

alex: Perfect. We'll track progress in the issue above and add periodic updates to the marketplace release notes. If anyone needs partner intros, ping me.
